events.headline: IRAN SAYS HORMUZ TO REMAIN CLOSED UNTIL US MEETS CONDITIONS
events.detail: Tehran says reopening Strait of Hormuz has been its main goal, while the US continues to focus on nuclear talks.

events.headline: IRANIAN MISSILE STRIKE INJURED EIGHT US MARINES – NBC
events.detail: Eight US Marines were injured in an Iranian missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, with the Pentagon declining to comment, NBC reports Read Full Article at RT.com
